state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4, first item on disk: `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]`.** `docs/decisions/0278.md` is still the design every stage builds to: § 2 the block and grants, § 4 the pool, § 5 search, § 8 types, § 10 error kinds.

`crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs`'s module doc owns the block's rules: the URL list (scheme checked at boot, parsed in full by `nvs_ldap::Url::parse` at the dial), the two `tls` words, the empty password and half-credential refusals, the 30s default timeout, the pool read through `nvs_config::db::pool_of`, and the trust-checked `tls_ca_file`. `LdapDirectory` and `CapLdap` are in `tree.rs`, `Cap::LdapConnect`/`LdapOpen`/`LdapCleartext` in `capability.rs` (`open` takes `*.`, `cleartext` has no `true`), and `ldap.*` `password` is a `secret.rs` pair. `default.toml` spells every key, and `crates/nvs-config/tests/ldap.rs` plus one case in `tests/secret.rs` pin it.

`rule:security/ldap-empty-password-is-refused` and `rule:security/ldap-cleartext-bind-is-granted-per-host` are `shipped`, guarded by `crates/nvs-ldap/tests/samba.rs` and `crates/nvs-config/tests/ldap.rs`. The other four ldap fragments are still `designed`. The Global Catalog ports 3268/3269 are not published yet.

next.title: `Core\Ldap`: connect, open, search, read
next.note: one file set: the new `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/Cargo.toml`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`, and the readers in `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs`.

items.text: **`Core\Ldap::connect` and `::open`, `Connection::search` and `::read`**, over `nvs_ldap::Connection::open` at `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs:213`: the `nvs-ldap` edge goes beside `nvs-db` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/Cargo.toml:68`, registry rows the way `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/registry.rs:228` declares `Core\Db::connect`, and the block read through `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs:52` (`urls_of`), `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs:63` (`tls_of`), `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs:77` (`timeout_for`) and `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs:105` (`pool_for`). `connect` asks `Cap::LdapConnect` by name and skips the address policy; `open` asks `Cap::LdapOpen` by host and passes the policy; a `tls = "none"` endpoint asks `Cap::LdapCleartext` for `Endpoint::cleartext_granted`. The URL list fails over in order and a credentials refusal stops the walk (ADR 0278 § 2). The pool per `rule:security/db-pool-reset-is-a-boundary` and `rule:security/ldap-pool-is-bound-as-its-block` (a connection that is not settled is closed, not pooled). ADR 0278 § 4, § 5. Closes `nvs-stdlib-ldap-connect-open-and-search`: the test target is `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs`, with the five test names the record lists.

**The two conformance cases** `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-and-search.nvst` and `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-without-a-grant-throws.nvst`, which close `ldap-connect-and-search-run`; the shape is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/registry.rs:228`'s `Core\Db` cases.

backlog: The URL list's failover walk (ADR 0278 § 2) belongs to Stage 4's `connect`, over `nvs_ldap::Connection::open` per URL.
Ranged-attribute merging, sort with VLV, deleted objects and DirSync are Stages 6 and 9; `nvs_ldap::proto::Control` is where their controls go.
Publish Samba's Global Catalog ports 3268/3269 in `tests/db/compose.yaml` before Stage 9's Global Catalog check.
A malformed host in an `[ldap]` URL is refused at the first dial, not at boot; `crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs`'s module doc says why.
